capabilities: Sync transcribed voice notes from the Epiphany app into the vault
Route notes to configurable destinations such as the daily note, an existing note, or a new file
Receive links, screenshots, photos, and files shared alongside voice notes
Authenticate with an Epiphany account via email and one-time password
extras: The plugin only writes to the vault and never reads existing files; transcription and sync go through the Epiphany server, and the mobile app itself may have costs not stated in the README.
motivation: The author built it so ideas can be captured the moment they hit, without waiting to sit down at a keyboard or doing manual steps.
problem: Capturing spoken thoughts on iPhone or Apple Watch and getting them into Obsidian normally requires manual export or copy-pasting.
summary: Companion plugin that syncs voice notes captured in the Epiphany iOS app into the vault as transcribed markdown.
